_about: Container-driven layout and computed theme colours, captured in a real browser. Neither is observable server-side: layout needs a ResizeObserver and a layout engine, and ThemeProvider injects its tokens from an effect. Reproduce with the commands in README.md.

pieChartLegendBreakpoint._claim: PieChart/types.ts documents the stacked legend as 'side by side from 400px wide, below the chart when narrower'. Measured below; the flip happens at exactly 400px.
pieChartLegendBreakpoint.verdict: Matches the documented behaviour exactly at the 400px boundary.

heatmapFollowsContainer._claim: HeatmapChart with NO width prop sizes itself from its container.
heatmapFollowsContainer.verdict: SVG width tracks the container 1:1; cells scale proportionally and the cell COUNT stays 18 (3 series x 6 categories) at every width.

computedThemeColours._about: The same AreaChart/BarChart/HeatmapChart under ThemeProvider mode=light vs mode=dark. Series fills are IDENTICAL across modes — the default chart palette is not theme-derived; only chrome (ticks, legend text) changes.
computedThemeColours.note: ThemeProvider emits CSS custom properties only; it paints no page surface. A consumer must supply one, or dark-mode text renders near-white on the browser's default white page. The fixture sets `background: var(--openui-background)` for exactly this reason — see fixtures/browser/main.tsx.

pieChartHeightOverflow._about: Evidence for DEFECT-002. PieChart given height={240}.
